messages:
Deepak: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we agreed to split remediation work and make alert changes in the next sprint. TL;DR: separate action items into noise/dedupe, thresholds, and paging cadence. Who can take which?
Amanda: I can own the dedupe changes (Alertmanager + Prom rules). Will prototype a suppress window.
Kevin: I can take thresholds and the 'warning' tier. I want to test a soft alarm channel before paging.
Sara: I'll handle paging rotation and runbook updates. FYI recurring pattern: KV cache warmups in us-west-2 causing repeat 5xx spikes → lots of dup pages.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4723 assigned to Amanda — priority: P2 — link: https://redwood/INF-4723
Amanda: initial approach: suppress repeats if "count >= 3 and window < 5m" then silence origin for 15m. Will open PR for rule and add tests.
Kevin: proposed thresholds: warning at 50% of current, page at 120% of baseline; test in staging first. Also suggest we route warnings to #infra-warnings and only escalate to #oncall after 2 failed checks within 10m.
Sara: for paging cadence I want a rotation tweak: shorten first escalation to 5m but increase dedupe window to avoid flapping. I'll update the pager schedule and runbook.
Deepak: ownership + rough timelines: Amanda (dedupe) due 2026-04-05, Kevin (thresholds) due 2026-04-12, Sara (paging + runbook) due 2026-03-30. Weekly sync Fridays 11:00 PT. I'll add owners to the postmortem doc.
Amanda: creating branch `alert/dedupe/INF-4723` and will link PR. Example rule I'll test in staging: `- alert: KVCacheHighErrors
  expr: increase(kv_errors_total[5m]) > 3
  annotations:
    summary: "KV cache errors spike"` — then dedupe via Alertmanager group_interval/silence.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for alertmgr changes on Wed 03:00 UTC — will rollback on failure.
Kevin: once staging looks good, add a short ramp in prod (10% nodes) then full rollout. Also propose adding a metric tag for "warmup" so we can exclude expected spikes.
Sara: I'll add a note in the runbook about the warmup tag and update postmortem with pattern examples.
Deepak: great. I'll capture all this in the postmortem follow-up table and assign calendar invites for the Friday check-ins. Thanks — small, focused changes should drop pager volume. :thumbsup:
